full_judgment: 2. Facts of the case, in brief, are that the petitioner as plaintiff, instituted Title Suit No. 849 of 2010 in the Court of Joint District Judge, First Court, Dhaka for cancellation of the registered Power of Attorney No. 23707 dated 23.09.2007/ 24.09.200 executed by the plaintiff in favour of defendant No. 2 and registered Kabla No. 8401 dated 27.10.2008 executed by defendant No. 2 in favour of defendant No. 1 and for declaring that those are inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiff. He also prayed for khas possession of the suit land. The plaintiff contended, inter alia, that he is a renowned businessman and industrialist. He got lease of 7 Katha 10 chatak and 36 square feet of land of Road No. 104 of Plot No. 8 of Gulshan Residential Area of Mouza-Bhola Samair under Police Station-Gulshan from RAJUK, defendant No. 5, vide registered Lease Deed No.9611 dated 24.07.1996. The plaintiff gave the said land in equitable mortgage to One Bank Limited, defendant No.6. One M/s. Jardi Steel for importing scrap vessel namely MT ELPIS Ex-AFRAGOLD COLORADO, GLOBTIC LONDON, took loan/ credit facilities from defendant No.3 bank by opening letters of credit and the plaintiff-petitioner herein became the guarantor for the said loan. On 01.11.2007 the political situation of Bangladesh changed. At that time law enforcing agencies in collusion with defendant Nos. 2, 3 and 4 illegally took the petitioner away to the Cantonment and by threatening him with death forcibly kept his signature on some blank papers and stamp papers and also seized valuable deeds of the plaintiff.
